goalie_shots_against.description: The total number of shots on goal against Goalie(s).

goalie_shots_against_per_game.description: The number of shots against a goalie(s).  * Does not include empty net goals, that is Team SA/G

goalie_special_teams_goals_against.description: Goals against while the opposing team is on the power play (goalie’s team is shorthanded) or opposing team is shorthanded (goalie’s team is on power play)

goalie_special_teams_save_pct.description: Save percentage while the opposing team is on the power play (goalie’s team is shorthanded) or opposing team is shorthanded (goalie’s team is on power play)

goalie_special_teams_saves.description: Saves while the opposing team is on the power play (goalie’s team is shorthanded) or opposing team is shorthanded (goalie’s team is on power play)

goalie_special_teams_shot_attempts_again.description: Shots against while the opposing team is on the power play (goalie’s team is shorthanded) or opposing team is shorthanded (goalie’s team is on power play)

goalie_time_on_ice.description: Total time on ice for goalies

goalie_time_on_ice_per_game.description: Time on ice per game for goalies

goalie_total_decisions.description: The number of decisions (W/L/T/OTL) attributed to that goalie. This is used to determine Goalie Win Percentage.

goalie_total_losses.description: Goalie received a Loss that game. (L: 0 team points)

goalie_total_overtime_losses.description: *Pre-2005, Teams were not awarded a point for an OTL

goalie_win_pct.description: The goalie's point percentage in games that they received a decision.

goals.description: The number of own goals scored in regulation and OT (does not include goal added for winning shootout)

goals_against.description: The number of opponent goals scored in regulation and OT (does not include goal added for winning shootout)

goals_against_per_game.description: The number of opponent goals scored per game in regulation and OT (does not include goal added for winning shootout)

goals_against_thru_second_period.description: Opponent goals in the game through the end of the 2nd period

goals_against_thru_third_period.description: Opponent goals in the game through the end of the 3rd period

goals_per_game.description: The number of own goals scored per game in regulation and OT (does not include goal added for winning shootout)

goals_thru_second_period.description: Goals scored in the game through the end of the 2nd period

goals_thru_third_period.description: Goals scored in the game through the end of the 3rd period.

hat_trick_games.description: Number of games with three or more goals scored by a player

hit_net_pct.description: The percent of total shot attempts that are shots on goal.

hits_per_game.description: The number of hits per game played.

hits_suffered.description: Number of hits suffered by a skater

home_penalty_killing_pct.description: Success rate of preventing a goal while shorthanded at home.

losses.description: The number of team losses (0 points) NOTE: does not include OTL (1 point).

missed_shots_per_game.description: The number of missed shots per game.

multi_assist_games.description: Games where a player recorded more than 1 assist

multi_goal_games.description: Games where a player scored more than 1 goal

multi_point_games.description: Games where a player scored more than 1 point

opp_blocked_shots.description: The number of shots blocked by the opponent.

opp_evenstrength_goals_per_game.description: Opponent goals scored while on even strength (5v5) (4v4) etc. per game

opp_first_period_shots.description: Shots against in the first period

opp_hits_per_game.description: The number of opponent hits per game.

opp_missed_shots.description: The number of opponent missed shots.

opp_missed_shots_per_game.description: The number of opponent missed shots per game.

opp_penalties_per_game.description: The number of opponent penalties per game.

opp_penalty_minutes.description: The number of opponent penalty minutes.

opp_penalty_minutes_per_game.description: The number of opponent penalty minutes per game.

opp_powerplay_goals.description: The number of opponent power play goals.

opp_powerplay_goals_per_game.description: The number of opponent power play goals per game.

opp_powerplay_opportunities.description: The number of opponent power play opportunities.

opp_powerplay_opportunities_per_game.description: The number of opponent power play opportunities per game.

opp_powerplay_shots.description: The number of opponent power play shots on goal.

opp_powerplay_shots_per_game.description: The number of opponent power plays shots on goal per game.

opp_powerplay_shots_per_powerplay.description: Opposing team's power play shots on goal per power play opportunity.

opp_second_period_shots.description: Shots against in the second period

opp_shootout_attempts.description: The number of opponent shootout attempts.

opp_shootout_goals.description: The number of opponent shootout goals.

opp_shorthanded_goals.description: The number of shorthanded goals scored by the opponent.

opp_shorthanded_goals_per_game.description: The number of opponent shorthanded goals per game.

opp_shorthanded_shots.description: The number of opponent short handed shots on goal.

opp_shorthanded_shots_per_game.description: The number of shorthanded shots on goal per game by the opponent.

opp_shot_attempts.description: Total Opponent Shot Attempts (opp shots on goal + opp missed shots + blocks)

opp_shot_attempts_per_game.description: Total Opponent Shot Attempts per game (opp shots on goal + opp missed shots + blocks)

opp_shots_per_game.description: Opponent Shots On Goal Per Game.

opp_third_period_shots.description: Shots against in the third period

over_pct.description: Percentage of Team Games where the total score was over the pre-game Over/Under goal total

overtime_goal_diff.description: Overtime goals scored minus overtime goals allowed (not including Shootouts)

overtime_losses.description: The number of team overtime losses (1 point). NOTE: includes Shootout Losses (1 point).

overtime_losses_no_shootout.description: The number of team overtime losses that did NOT go to a shootout.

overtime_wins.description: Team wins in overtime - does not include regulation or shootout wins.

p_pts_diff_home_road.description: Difference between player points (goals plus assists) in home games vs. road games, negative indicates more on the road.

penalties_drawn.description: Number of penalties drawn by a player

penalties_served.description: Number of penalties served by a player

penalty_killing_pct.description: Success rate of preventing a goal while shorthanded

penalty_minutes_per_game.description: The number of penalty minutes per game.

penalty_shot_missed.description: Number of penalty shots that missed the net completely

penalty_shot_pct.description: Percentage of scoring on penalty shot attempts (penalty shot goals / penalty shot attempts).

penalty_shots_on_goal.description: The number of skater penalty shots that were on goal (excludes shots that missed the net)

player_assist_pct_team_goals.description: Player, percent of team goals where a player assisted on the goal. MUST USE TEAM GROUPING

player_pct_team_assists.description: Players, percentage of team's assists. MUST USE TEAM GROUPING

player_pct_team_evenstrength_assists.description: Players, percentage of team's even strength assists. MUST USE TEAM GROUPING

player_pct_team_evenstrength_goals.description: Players, percent of team even strength goals (does not include goals awarded for Shootout Wins in calculation) where a player scored the goal. MUST USE TEAM GROUPING

player_pct_team_evenstrength_points.description: Players, percentage of Team's Goals scored (does not include goals awarded for Shootout Wins in calculation) + team's assists when a team is even strength. MUST USE TEAM GROUPING

player_pct_team_face_offs.description: Players, percentage of Team's Face Offs Taken

player_pct_team_goals.description: Players, percentage of Team's Goals scored (does not include goals awarded for Shootout Wins in calculation) MUST USE TEAM GROUPING.

player_pct_team_points.description: Players, percentage of Team's Goals scored (does not include goals awarded for Shootout Wins in calculation) + team's assists. MUST USE TEAM GROUPING

player_pct_team_powerplay_assists.description: Players, percentage of team's power play assists. MUST USE TEAM GROUPING

player_pct_team_powerplay_goals.description: Player, percent of team power play goals (does not include goals awarded for Shootout Wins in calculation) where a player scored the goal. MUST USE TEAM GROUPING

player_pct_team_powerplay_points.description: Players, percentage of Team's Goals scored (does not include goals awarded for Shootout Wins in calculation) + team's assists on the power play. MUST USE TEAM GROUPING

player_pct_team_shots.description: Players, percentage of Team's Shots on Goal

player_point_assist_pct.description: The percent of player points that are assists.

player_point_goal_pct.description: The percent of player points that are goals.

player_point_pct_team_goals.description: Player, percent of team goals where a player either scored or assisted on the goal. MUST USE TEAM GROUPING

player_points.description: Goals plus assists equals player points.

player_powerplay_points.description: The number of power play points for a player.

playoff_season.description: Seasons in which the team made the playoffs.

point_pct_powerplay.description: Percent of player points that come on the power play.

powerplay_assist_pct.description: Percent of assists on the power play

powerplay_assists_per_game.description: The number of power play assists per game.

powerplay_goal_diff.description: Power play goals scored minus opponent power play goals scored (team).

powerplay_goal_pct.description: Percent of goals scored when team is on power play.

powerplay_goals_per_game.description: The number of power play goals per game.

powerplay_opportunities_per_game.description: The number of power play opportunities per game.

powerplay_pct.description: Power play goals / power play opportunities.

powerplay_pct_at_home.description: Power play goals / power play opportunities for games played at Home

powerplay_pct_on_road.description: Power play goals / power play opportunities for games played on the Road

powerplay_pct_plus_penalty_kill_pct.description: The sum of a teams' power play percentage and their penalty-kill percentage.

powerplay_points_per_game.description: The number of power play points per game.

powerplay_shooting_pct.description: Shooting percentage on the power play (team or player)

powerplay_shots_per_game.description: The number of power play shots per game.

powerplay_shots_per_powerplay.description: The number of power play shots on goal per power play opportunity.

road_penalty_killing_pct.description: Success rate of preventing a goal while shorthanded on the road.

second_period_goal_diff.description: 2nd Period goals scored minus 2nd period goals allowed

second_period_goal_pct.description: Percent of total goals scored in second period.

second_period_shot_diff.description: Shots on goal differential in the second period

second_period_shots.description: Shots on goal in the second period

shifts_per_games_played.description: The number of shifts per games played.

shooting_pct.description: The number percentage of goals to shots on goal.

shootout_pct.description: Percentage of scoring on shootout attempts (shootout goals / shootout attempts).

shorthanded_assists.description: The assists that occur when the opposing team has an advantage in players.

shorthanded_goal_diff.description: Short handed goals scored minus opponent short handed goals scored (team).

shorthanded_goal_pct.description: Percentage of goals scored while shorthanded (Short handed goals divided by all goals).

shorthanded_goals.description: Number of goals scored while the opposing team has a player advantage.

shorthanded_goals_per_game.description: Number of goals scored while the opposing team has a player advantage per game.

shorthanded_player_points.description: The number of shorthanded player points.

shot_attempt_diff.description: The difference between Total Shot Attempts (shots on goal + missed shots + attempts blocked by opponent) and Opponent Total Shot Attempts.

shot_attempts.description: Total Shot Attempts (shots on goal + missed shots + attempts blocked by opponent).

shot_attempts_blocked.description: Shot Attempts Blocked by Opponent Skater

shot_attempts_blocked_per_game.description: Number of Shot Attempts by a Skater that are blocked by the opponent, per game

shot_attempts_per_game.description: Shot Attempts per Game (shots on goal + missed shots + attempts blocked by opponent).

shots_against.description: The number of opponent shots on goal (includes empty net goals against).

shots_against_per_game.description: The number of opponent shots on goal per game (includes empty net goals against).

shots_diff_per_game.description: The average difference in shots on goal per game.

shots_on_goal.description: Shots on goal (shots that are either saved by the opposing goalie or result in a goal scored).

shots_on_goal_diff.description: Shots on Goal - Opponent Shots on Goal.

shots_per_game.description: The number of shots on goal per game.

skater_evenstrength_time_on_ice.description: Time on ice for skaters while team is even strength.

skater_evenstrength_time_on_ice_per_game.description: Time on ice per game for skaters while team is even strength.

skater_minutes.description: The total number of minutes on ice.

skater_powerplay_time_on_ice.description: Time on ice for skaters while team is on power play.

skater_powerplay_time_on_ice_per_game.description: Time on Ice per game for skaters while team is on power play.

skater_shorthanded_time_on_ice.description: Time on ice for skaters while team is shorthanded.

skater_shorthanded_time_on_ice_per_game.description: Time on Ice per game for skaters while team is shorthanded.

skater_time_on_ice_per_game.description: The amount of time on ice per game.

special_teams_goal_diff.description: Special team goals scored minus opponent special team goals scored (team).

special_teams_goals.description: Goals scored while player's team is on the power play or player's team is shorthanded.

special_teams_goals_against.description: Opponent goals scored while player's team is on the power play or player's team is shorthanded.

takeaways_per_game.description: The number of takeaways per game.

team_blown_lead_losses.description: Losses after leading at any point in game (includes Overtime Losses).

team_comeback_wins.description: Wins after trailing at any point in game.

team_evenstrength_time_on_ice.description: Time on ice for teams while even strength.

team_evenstrength_time_on_ice_per_game.description: The average time on ice per game for teams while even strength

team_goal_diff_including_shooutout.description: The differential between own and opponent score (including the goals added for winning a shootout).

team_goals_against_avg_including_empty_n.description: Team Goals Against Average (including empty net goals).

team_goals_against_including_shootout.description: The opponent score (including the goal added for winning a shootout).

team_goals_including_shootout.description: The team score (including the goal added for winning a shootout).

team_point_pct.description: The teams point percentage (NHL's version of win percentage).

team_point_pct_at_home.description: The teams point percentage (NHL's version of win percentage) at home.

team_point_pct_diff_home_road.description: The difference between a team's point percentage (NHL's version of win percentage) in home games vs. road games, negative indicates better on the road.

team_point_pct_on_road.description: The teams point percentage (NHL's version of win percentage) in road games

team_points_earned.description: The number of team points earned based on the result of the game (W=2, L=0, T=1, OTL=1).

team_points_earned_at_home.description: Team points in home games. (W=2, L=0, T=1, OTL=1).

team_points_earned_on_road.description: Team points in road games. (W=2, L=0, T=1, OTL=1).

team_powerplay_time_on_ice.description: Time on ice for teams while on the power play.

team_powerplay_time_on_ice_per_game.description: The average time on ice per game for teams while on the power play.

team_regulation_and_overtime_wins.description: Team wins in regulation and overtime - does not include shootout wins.

team_regulation_wins.description: Team wins in regulation - does not include overtime or shootout wins.

team_save_pct_incl_empty_net_goals.description: The percentage of shots on goal stopped by a team (including empty net goals).

team_shootout_losses.description: The number of team shootout losses

team_shootout_wins.description: The number of team shootout wins

team_shorthanded_time_on_ice.description: Time on ice for teams while shorthanded

team_shorthanded_time_on_ice_per_game.description: The average time on ice per game for teams while shorthanded

team_ties.description: The number of team ties (1 point).

team_time_on_ice.description: The total time the team was on the ice (including OT).

team_time_on_ice_per_game.description: The average time on ice for teams per game

team_win_pct.description: Total wins (Regulation/Overtime/Shootout) plus Team ties divided by 2, divided by total games played

team_wins.description: The number of team wins (2 points).

third_period_goal_diff.description: 3rd Period goals scored minus 3rd period goals allowed

third_period_goal_pct.description: Percent of total goals scored in third period.

third_period_goals.description: Goals scored in the third period

third_period_shot_diff.description: Shots on goal differential in the third period

third_period_shots.description: Shots on goal in the third period

under_pct.description: Percentage of Team Games where the total score was under the pre-game Over/Under goal total

underdog_losses.description: Games lost where the team was the underdog based on the pre-game moneyline odds

underdog_win_pct.description: Team Win Percentage in games where the team was the underdog based on the pre-game moneyline odds

underdog_wins.description: Games won where the team was the underdog based on the pre-game moneyline odds
